result.title: Displacement Moments and Path-Terminal Separation in Brownian Interpolant Sampling
result.comment: 56 pages, 4 figures; 8-page main text and complete appendices
result.summary: Brownian stochastic interpolants connect paired endpoint samples, yet their sampling error can depend on displacement moments even when neither endpoint has a first moment. For arbitrary Borel couplings, we prove early-stopped, target-to-output KL guarantees for standard Euler sampling from the true source. A fourth displacement moment gives an explicit $O(N^{-1})$ bound; a second moment suffices for fixed-law convergence as drift error vanishes. For one fixed coupling with no displacement moment above two, original bridge-path KL stays of order one, comparison-path KL is of order $1/\log N$, and terminal KL is at most $C/N^2$ on the same grid. The path decomposition identifies the information about the source discarded by Markov projection. When the original bridge is Markov, current-state Euler sampling instead has a second-moment $O((M_2+d)/N)$ bound; finite-entropy Schroedinger bridges for the probability Brownian reference are included. We also construct a current-state learner with expected output KL consistency from iid endpoint pairs. Numerical diagnostics illustrate the distinct errors. Conditional diffusion identities specify a restoration interface, while image controls find no iterative advantage over cheap probabilistic predictors. Uniform terminal rates for general second-moment couplings remain open.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 Brownian stochastic interpolant 的采样误差，在仅有二阶位移矩甚至无矩的条件下给出 Euler 采样早停的 KL 保证，并通过路径分解区分原始桥路径与 Markov 投影路径的误差阶，还构造了基于独立同分布端点对的 current-state 学习器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「Markov 投影丢弃源信息」的路径 KL 分解可供核查 latent 推理状态更新中的信息坍缩，迭代采样相对廉价一步预测「无优势」的图像对照也可能类比多步 latent 推理的收益与成本评估。
